checks.detail: Web, Rust, native and project authorities identify 5.0.1 while schema remains frozen.
The multilingual typography floor and semantic type roles are centralized.
Dark/light surface hierarchy and role colors are centralized.
Purposeful press feedback and reduced-motion fallback coexist.
Workspace, history, layout, focus, management and command/search paths remain wired.
Workspace chrome has named responsive groups and localized context.
The scene toolbar does not depend on horizontal browser scrolling.
Transform, edit, draw, arrange, snapping, guide, camera and grouping capabilities remain reachable.
Secondary scene controls are organized in named popovers.
Context actions use readable two-line labels and a distinct creation role.
Workspace popovers stack above scene chrome instead of appearing beneath it.
en contains the 5.0.1 editor-chrome and migration-preflight vocabulary.
de contains the 5.0.1 editor-chrome and migration-preflight vocabulary.
zh contains the 5.0.1 editor-chrome and migration-preflight vocabulary.
Migration preflight labels and details switch with the selected language.
Registry-generated accessible names and disabled reasons follow live language changes.
Every statically referenced translation key is declared in the bundled vocabulary.
App-native confirmation is present and source code does not call browser confirm/alert/prompt.
instructions.txt is the authoritative complete 5.0.1 UX specification.
README, UX guide and three Markdown manuals describe the new organization.
Frozen public and user-experience contracts are explicitly preserved.
